featured_title: Copperleaf vs. Spring Run at The Brooks, Estero FL: Which Is Right for You? 2026
featured_excerpt: Copperleaf and Spring Run sit behind the same gates in The Brooks, share the same Commons Club and the same Brooks CDD, and both bundle 18 holes of golf into ownership — yet Copperleaf costs about $5,800 a year more. Roughly $3,500 of that gap is the Project 2024 assessment, a term charge on a clubhouse loan scheduled to finish in 2036, which means most of the difference between these two communities has an end date.
